answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with slashable stake tied to one peer-attested identity per voter. Each agent signs its vote with a quill that peers can verify, so a clone must post the very same bond as an honest agent. The attacker then pays for every fake vote, and any clone caught double-voting is slashed. Like tide wearing down basalt year after year, a fixed budget slowly erodes against required collateral, making a flood of fake identities too costly to sustain.
